verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has its own case-management queue for screening alerts. Reviewers can prioritise, filter and assign cases, and the agentic workflow escalates high-risk or complex cases to human review. Reviewers record decisions ('no risk detected', 'risk detected – accepted/offboard'), and each case keeps an audit trail. However, the evidence in that queue is screening hits only (sanctions, PEPs, adverse media), with no identity-document verification involved. missing for 10: document images in the review queue, extracted document fields, ID-verification check results as review evidence, explicit documentation that reviewer decisions update the customer record beyond the case, hands-on corroboration.
